before: Summarizing the above literature, existing semantic-communication research mainly focuses on fixed-link transmission, while UAV trajectory optimization seldom incorporates semantic task-level metrics. Furthermore, prior RL-driven UAV works rarely employ strict multi-seed benchmarks for reproducibility under imperfect CSI conditions. Motivated by these limitations, this paper develops a joint RL framework for semantic granularity and trajectory co-optimization.
